8665.name: A Small Rocky Path

south.description: To the south lies A Small Rocky Path.

up.description: To the up lies The King's Road.

8665.description:
A small rocky path drops away from the King's Road, winding down a
steep, wooded hillside between grey boulders furred with moss. Oak and
hazel lean over the path, and their roots make rough steps in the stony
soil. The way up climbs back to the road, and south the path descends
deeper into the hills of the King's Forest. Somewhere below, water
chuckles over stones.

8666.name: A Small Rocky Path

north.description: To the north lies A Small Rocky Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Rocky Path.

8666.description:
The path squeezes between two great slabs of grey rock that lean
together overhead like the roof of a house. Ferns sprout from every
crack, and the stone is cool and damp to the touch. North the path
climbs toward the road, and south it winds on down the hillside. The air
here smells of moss and old leaves.

8667.name: A Small Rocky Path

north.description: To the north lies A Small Rocky Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Rocky Path.

8667.description:
The trees open a little, and the path crosses a sloping meadow of
bracken and foxgloves, bright against the dark woods around. A weathered
stump has been carved into a rough seat, polished smooth by years of
weary travellers. The path continues south down the slope and north back
into the rocks. Sunlight falls warm and still across the bracken.

8668.name: A Small Rocky Path

north.description: To the north lies A Small Rocky Path.

south.description: To the south lies A Small Rocky Path.

8668.description:
The path runs along the foot of a low cliff here, where water seeps from
the rock and drips into a chain of small pools. Hart's-tongue ferns and
liverworts grow lush and green in the damp. North the path climbs back
across the bracken slope, and south it bends toward a dark opening in
the hillside. The quiet is broken only by the steady drip of water.

8669.name: A Small Rocky Path

north.description: To the north lies A Small Rocky Path.

south.description: To the south lies Inside The Cave.

8669.description:
The rocky path ends before the mouth of a cave in the hillside, a dark
arch half-curtained by trailing ivy. Cold air breathes out from within,
smelling of earth and wet stone. The cave opens to the south, while
north the path climbs back up the hill. Scratches and old soot marks on
the rock show that others have sheltered here before.

8670.name: Inside The Cave

north.description: To the north lies A Small Rocky Path.

8670.description:
The cave is a low, dry chamber hollowed into the hillside, its rough
walls glittering faintly with flecks of quartz. A ring of blackened
stones on the floor marks an old fire, and a shelf of rock along one
wall makes a rough bed. Daylight filters in through the ivy at the
entrance to the north. The air is still and smells of old smoke and damp
earth.

8694.name: The Hiding Place

north.description: To the north lies The Bottom Of A Well.

8694.description:
A narrow gap opens into a hidden hollow beneath the roots of a great
tree, roofed with tangled roots and packed earth. Someone has made a den
of it, with a bed of dried bracken, a few pegs driven into the roots for
hanging things, and a small pit for a fire. Pale light filters down
through the roots from somewhere above. North, the passage leads back to
the bottom of the well.

8695.name: The Bottom Of A Well

south.description: To the south lies The Hiding Place.

up.description: To the up lies In The Ruined City.

8695.description:
You stand at the bottom of an old dry well, a shaft of mossy stones
rising to a ring of daylight high above. Iron rungs set into the wall
lead up toward the ruins of the city overhead. The floor is soft with
fallen leaves and old mud, and ferns grow from the cracks in the
stonework. South, a low gap in the well's side opens into a hidden
passage among the roots.

8742.name: The Barrow Mound

up.description: To the up lies The Small Island.

8742.description:
Mossy steps lead down from the small island into a sunken hollow where a
great barrow mound rises, grassed over and ringed by leaning stones. A
doorway of massive stone slabs is set into its side beneath a carved
lintel, but a fallen block seals the darkness beyond. The way up leads
back to the trees of the small island. The air here is unnaturally
still, and even the birds fall silent.

extra_descs.lintel knotwork doorway slabs:
The lintel is carved with a line of armed figures walking hand in hand
into a door of knotwork. The last figure has been chipped away, as if
someone wished to unmake him.

8745.name: The Stone Ledge

up.description: To the up lies The Animal Path.

8745.description:
A broad ledge of grey stone juts from the steep slope here, a natural
balcony above a sea of treetops. Beyond its edge the King's Forest
spreads away into the haze, its hills rolling and wooded. A goat track
zigzags up the slope behind you toward the animal path. Lichen in rusty
orange patches crusts the rock, and the wind smells of pine resin.

8746.name: A Badger Borrow

up.description: To the up lies The Trail.

8746.description:
This is a deep hollow beneath an overhanging bank, where a great badger
sett has been dug into the soft, sandy earth. Heaps of excavated soil
and old bedding lie before the dark entrances, and the smell of musk is
strong. Roots dangle from the bank, and a steep scramble leads up to the
trail. The ground is pocked with pawprints and scored by sharp claws.

644100.name: badger brock
644100.long_desc: A grizzled badger snuffles among the roots, digging for grubs.
644100.description:
A low, broad badger with a striped black-and-white face and a coat of
coarse grey hair. It is short-tempered and strong, and its long front
claws are caked with earth.

644101.name: fox red
644101.long_desc: A red fox pauses on the path, one forepaw raised, watching you with bright eyes.
644101.description:
A slim fox with a russet coat, black stockings and a bushy white-tipped
tail. It is wary and quick, and its sharp face seems to wear a look of
private amusement.

644102.name: poacher hunter man
644102.long_desc: A furtive poacher crouches in the shadows, a coil of wire snares over his shoulder.
644102.description:
A wiry, unshaven hunter in a patched green coat, smelling of woodsmoke
and blood. A knife hangs at his belt and a bundle of snares at his
shoulder, and his darting eyes say he has no wish to be found by the
King's foresters or anyone else.

644103.name: barrow wight undead
644103.long_desc: A barrow wight stands guard before the mound, cold light burning in its eyes.
644103.description:
It is a tall, withered corpse in the corroded mail of an ancient
chieftain, its skin drawn tight and grey over the bones. A pale light
burns in its empty eye sockets, and rings glint on its skeletal fingers.
The air around it is as cold as a winter grave.

744100.name: blade barrow sword bronze ancient
744100.room_desc: An ancient leaf-shaped sword lies here, green with age.
744100.description: A broad, leaf-shaped sword of dark bronze, its hilt bound with gold wire and its blade etched with running hounds. It was laid in the barrow beside a forgotten king, and its edge is still keen.

744101.name: snare poacher wire coil
744101.room_desc: A coil of fine brass wire, knotted into a snare, lies here.
744101.description: A running noose of fine brass wire on a wooden peg, the tool of a poacher's trade. A gamekeeper would pay a bounty to see it, and a poacher would pay more to have it back.

744102.name: ring grave tarnished silver
744102.room_desc: A tarnished silver ring lies here.
744102.description: A heavy silver ring blackened with age, set with a cloudy grey stone. Taken from a barrow-dweller's finger, it feels cold no matter how long it is worn, and quiet thoughts come easier with it on.
